class.name: CubismMotionDescriptor
class.brief_description: Imported metadata and dependencies for one native motion.
class.description: Serializable data shared by independent runtime motion instances. This resource does not load files, start motion/audio playback or execute event strings. Setters preserve supplied values and emit [signal Resource.changed]; consumers validate catalog identity and must not modify shared descriptors during playback.

members.member: Optional serialized [Animation] reference reserved for later timeline-conversion work. Native motion playback does not require this field and full-fidelity conversion is not implemented.
Validated source motion duration in seconds.
Ordered [CubismMotionEvent] metadata. Runtime motion handles provide timing and deferred notification semantics.
Imported motion fade-in override. -1 preserves an absent override until source parsing resolves it.
Imported motion fade-out override. -1 preserves an absent override until source parsing resolves it.
Stable imported motion ID in Group/index form. Setters do not derive or repair it automatically.
Zero-based ordered index within the manifest group. Reordering the manifest can change IDs.
Source loop metadata. Runtime playback owns its selected loop state independently.
Extra imported motion metadata retained for inspection.
Real imported [AudioStream] dependency for a declared sound. The descriptor does not play it; direct [method CubismModel2D.play_motion] does not start audio.
Normalized declared sound path, or an empty string when no sound is declared.
